title: Dexcom G6 authentication errors
symptom: After entering transmitter ID via source wizard, status shows 'connecting' and 'authorizing' but never progresses; scanning errors grow. Log shows Ob1G5StateMachine authentication notification throwable (CHECK_AUTH) with BleDisconnectedException and GATT exception on characteristic read.
fix: Update to the latest nightly build (as suggested by maintainer jamorham). The issue was marked as resolved after that, but no specific fix details were given.
evidence_quote: Please try with the latest nightly - see here: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/wiki/How-to-get-the-Nightlies-on-Automatic-Update I would expect the configuration you are using to work.
